capabilities: Step through sequence diagram messages with keyboard or toolbar
View diagrams as a step list with pinned participants and phase headings
Arrange participants as draggable cards on a canvas map
Name phases using rect blocks or spanning notes
Open walkthroughs beside the note or inline in place of the diagram
disambiguation: Not a tutorial on Mermaid syntax; it steps through sequence diagrams already written in your notes.
extras: The listing notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Includes a caveat that phase names placed after rect rgb(...) render as a black box.
intentEvidence: An Obsidian plugin to walk through Mermaid sequence diagrams one step at a time
problem: Obsidian renders Mermaid sequence diagrams as static images, so there is no way to follow a conversation one message at a time.

relations.evidence: walk through Mermaid sequence diagrams one step at a time

summary: Interactive viewer that steps through Mermaid sequence diagrams one message at a time, as a pinned step list or a draggable participant map.
